source_summary: Vertical Chinese ink landscape with layered mountains, mist, clustered buildings, waterways, bridges, pines, willows, bamboo, rocks, and villages. Seals, calligraphy, labels, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif selections.

motifs.name: upper_central_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the towering central upper mountain wall with steep folded ridges, dark ink contour lines, pale washes, clustered summit trees, and the narrow terrace-like ledge near the top. Avoid nearby red seals.
must_preserve: small dark tree clusters on ridges

motifs.name: left_misty_cliff_pillars
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow left-side cliff spires emerging from mist, including the high vertical pillar with shrubs on its crown and the smaller mist-veiled peak below it. Exclude adjacent seals.
must_preserve: thin contour linework on sheer faces
dark shrub dots along cliff tops
pale mist gaps around the bases

motifs.name: midleft_pavilion_grove_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left hillside settlement with multi-tier pavilion roofs, clustered houses, surrounding pines and deciduous trees, and terraced rocky slopes descending toward the water.
must_preserve: tree crowns made of dots and short strokes

motifs.name: midright_pine_rocky_hill
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right rounded rocky hill mass with two tall pines, a small upper ledge with sparse pines, distant pale peaks behind, and layered ridge strokes.
must_preserve: paired pine trunks and needle clusters

motifs.name: right_bank_village_willows_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the right-bank waterside village group with low buildings, covered bridge or walkway, railings, willows, clustered trees, and sloping shoreline.
must_preserve: rectangular house walls and roof planes
small tree and reed marks near the water

motifs.name: lower_left_lakeside_pavilion_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left lakeside pavilion on a rocky bank with a tall bare-branched tree, smaller foliage, shore rocks, and calm water edge.
must_preserve: tall tree trunk with bare branches
dark foliage dots and leaf clusters

motifs.name: foreground_pine_bamboo_rock_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the prominent lower-right foreground grove with leaning pines, bamboo leaves, shrubs, and rocky base, including the expressive twisting trunks and dense needle clusters.
must_preserve: twisted pine trunks with bark dots
slender bamboo stems and pointed leaves
rock base contour and wash texture

motifs.name: central_lake_rock_islet_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the central lake passage with the broken eroded rock islet, sparse reeds and willow-like grasses, low shoreline marks, and broad open water washes.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
